posts.text:
Don’t love the vague note about “digital trade alignment” in the US statement on whatever agreement is coming.

Canada is already limited in how it can regulate US tech companies due to CUSMA/USMCA. The last thing we need is for our ability to rein in those bad actors to be constrained even further.

posts.text:
Taylor Lorenz listed out all the generative AI apps she uses for Substack, including Elon Musk’s Grok, and is shocked her followers are mad.

She wants to have it both ways: to present herself as critical and progressive while still getting to take the same immoral actions as people who don’t.
